data_scope: 10-year nominal Treasury notes, 2008-05-07 to 2026-10-07; daily Treasury 10-year par yields 2008-01-02 to 2026-11-23
disposition: INCONCLUSIVE — mixed predictive evidence; do not promote or claim an economic edge

event_construction.model_training_rule: Only prior events whose five-business-day target end date is strictly before the current auction record_date are eligible.

limitations: This is a forecast backtest on official par-yield observations, not a tradable futures/ETF P&L.
No CAGR, Sharpe, Sortino, turnover or drawdown is claimed.
Auction result publication is conservatively lagged: the target starts at the first yield-curve observation strictly after record_date.
The Treasury par yield curve is a reference curve, not an executable quote.
No forward-filling or synthetic observations are used.
Incremental predictive value requires independent robustness and a separate tradable-instrument data source before any economic interpretation.
